description: This pie chart illustrates the "Distribution of data source in the combined training set," displaying a total of thirteen distinct categories. The chart does not utilize a separate legend or internal percentage labels; rather, each slice is identified by an external text label and a corresponding percentage, which are connected to their respective segments via thin grey lines. The slices do not appear to be arranged in any specific order, such as by descending size, and none are visually emphasized through explosion or offsetting. Proceeding clockwise from the top right, the largest slice is colored blue and accounts for 31.3% of the total, though its specific text label is obscured by a solid grey rectangle. Continuing clockwise, the subsequent slices include a very thin dark sliver labeled SCIFACT (0.1%), a yellow slice for ENTFA (1.8%), a green slice for FACTCC (2.6%), an orange slice for ANLI (4.6%), a teal slice for FEVER (16.1%), a thin light blue slice for MULTIFC (0.5%), a light red slice for MULTINLI (11.3%), a thin yellow slice for PUBHEALTH (0.5%), a green slice for SCITAIL (1.2%), an orange slice for SNLI (15.4%), a cyan or light blue slice for VITAMINC (13.0%), and finally a very light blue slice for XSUMHUL (1.6%).
